svg.title: Горизонтальные подтягивания на кольцах — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Inverted horizontal bodyweight row on gymnastic rings. Side-three-quarter camera shows the chest-up body in a straight diagonal line from planted heels to shoulders, head close to floor; heels stay planted at same point on floor both phases. Athlete's face points up. Two identical rings hang from overhead straps, one ring in each hand. LEFT: both arms extended upwards toward rings and body hangs low. RIGHT: pulls chest UP to rings, bending both elbows backward and keeping hips straight. No pushup, no dip. Straps clearly connect to overhead anchor, visible full body and heels. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
